prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: revised high-fidelity desktop app design comp
Primary request: Revise the supplied RC WORKSHOP composition option B to show the active internal-components inspection mode.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and must define the entire UI layout, typography, palette and component design.
Required change: remove the vehicle body shell completely from the central 3D viewport. Do not make it transparent or ghosted. Show only the complete rolling chassis and internal systems: ladder frame, front and rear axles, suspension, steering, motor, gearbox, transfer case, driveshafts, battery, ESC, receiver tray, wiring, wheels and body-mount posts. Preserve the selected front shock highlighted in safety orange.
Add a compact two-state segmented control near the bottom-left viewport controls with exact labels "Снаружи" and "Внутренности"; "Внутренности" is active in orange. Add a small low-emphasis action "Показать кузов" nearby.
Keep unchanged: full application composition, left icon rail, top subsystem tabs, large central viewport proportions, right selected-part inspector, before/after metrics, compatible alternatives table, bottom dependency chain, dark graphite palette, orange accent, Russian labels, sharp industrial visual language.
Constraints: the chassis must remain centered and large enough to inspect; internal assemblies should be much easier to see than in the original; no floating detached body shell anywhere; body disappears entirely in this mode; maintain professional production-ready interface fidelity.
Avoid: changing the overall layout, transparent body, cutaway body, isolated product photo, new colors, neon glow, generic cards, marketing design, watermark.
